source: Organizations that serve queer Jews, or queer people, or Jews, on money and the things money touches. Public organizations, with their own public addresses.
confidenceNote: A list of doors, not a recommendation. Organizations change names, close and merge; the address may have moved by the time you read this. If a link is dead, the name will still search. Nothing on this page costs money to ask.

groups.label: Queer Jewish community
groups.plain: Where being both is the starting point.

items.name: Keshet
items.plain: Works for LGBTQ+ equality in Jewish life; runs Shabbatonim, trainings and a directory of welcoming communities.

items.name: Eshel
items.plain: Community and support for LGBTQ+ Jews from Orthodox homes, and their families.

items.name: JQY (Jewish Queer Youth)
items.plain: Support, a drop-in center and crisis help for LGBTQ+ Jewish youth, especially from Orthodox and Hasidic communities.

items.name: SVARA
items.plain: A traditionally radical yeshiva: queer-led Talmud study, open to all, sliding scale.

items.name: Congregation Beit Simchat Torah
items.plain: The LGBTQ+ synagogue in New York; services online too.

items.name: A Wider Bridge
items.plain: Connects LGBTQ+ communities in North America and Israel.

groups.label: Interest-free loans and emergency help
groups.plain: Money without a lender's price on it.

items.name: International Association of Jewish Free Loans
items.plain: The directory of Hebrew free loan societies. The Gemach page says how they work.

items.name: Jewish Family Service (your city)
items.plain: Nearly every city has one: emergency grants, food, counseling, case management. Search 'Jewish Family Service' plus your city; the Network of Jewish Human Service Agencies lists them.

items.name: Jewish Federations of North America
items.plain: Your local Federation funds the agencies above and often runs an emergency fund.

items.name: Point of Pride
items.plain: Free binders and femme shapewear, and funds for surgery, hormones and electrolysis.

items.name: Trans Lifeline microgrants
items.plain: Small grants for name changes and IDs, and a peer support line.

groups.label: Legal protection for families like yours
groups.plain: The papers on the Chosen Family page, and who helps with them.

items.name: Lambda Legal
items.plain: LGBTQ+ civil rights law; a help desk and plain guides on protecting your family.

items.name: National Center for Lesbian Rights
items.plain: Legal help and guides on marriage, parentage and second-parent adoption.

items.name: Family Equality
items.plain: For LGBTQ+ families and those becoming one: family-building guides, state-by-state law, and cost information.

items.name: Advocates for Trans Equality
items.plain: The ID documents center: how to change your name and gender marker in each state and on federal papers.

items.name: Transgender Law Center
items.plain: Legal information and a help line for trans and nonbinary people.

groups.label: Money help without the sales pitch
groups.plain: People whose job is to help, not to sell.

items.name: Association for Financial Counseling and Planning Education
items.plain: Find an accredited financial counselor. Many work on a sliding scale or free through a nonprofit.

items.name: SAGE
items.plain: Advocacy and services for LGBTQ+ elders: benefits counseling, housing, a hotline.

items.name: Money Rooms
items.plain: The bigger app this one sits beside: the whole household's numbers, one owner a field. Same rules, more rooms.
